title: Junior Scheduler / Project Controls Consultant
description: SOCOTEC is a provider of niche consulting services within the architecture, engineering and construction industries focusing on high-performance buildings and specialty structures. Through an integrated, holistic approach, our professionals provide solutions for building envelope, energy efficiency, sustainability, code advisory and construction advisory projects. SOCOTEC’s combination of expertise, experience and methods are increasingly recognized as best-in-class fueling significant growth. SOCOTEC offers competitive salary and benefits, mentorship, training, and social activities. SOCOTEC is proud to announce that it has been officially certified as a Great Place to Work by the renowned global authority on workplace culture, Great Place to Work®. We are seeking a Junior Scheduler / Project Controls Consultant to support our growing project advisory and construction consulting practice. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional with hands-on experience developing and maintaining construction schedules who is looking to expand their capabilities in project controls, schedule analysis, and construction advisory. The successful candidate will ideally have approximately two years of experience working with a general contractor, construction manager, specialty contractor, or similar construction organization, with direct exposure to developing, updating, and managing construction schedules. The role will support projects across the building and infrastructure sectors and will work closely with senior schedulers, project controls professionals, project managers, and technical experts. Key Responsibilities Assist in the development, review, and maintenance of detailed construction project schedules. Develop and update Critical Path Method (CPM) schedules based on project scope, construction sequencing, and contractor work plans. Support preparation of baseline schedules, schedule updates, recovery schedules, and short-term look-ahead schedules. Review contractor schedule submissions for completeness, logic, sequencing, durations, and compliance with project requirements. Monitor project progress and incorporate actual progress into schedule updates. Identify critical and near-critical activities, schedule constraints, and potential impacts to project milestones. Assist with analysis of schedule variances and changes to the critical path. Work with project teams to collect schedule information, progress data, and supporting documentation. Assist in preparing schedule narratives, progress reports, schedule graphics, and management presentations. Support schedule impact assessments and preliminary delay analyses under the direction of senior scheduling and claims professionals. Assist with evaluating change orders and potential time impacts. Review project documentation, including drawings, specifications, contracts, progress reports, RFIs, submittals, and change documentation, to understand project sequencing and schedule impacts. Participate in project meetings and schedule review meetings with clients, contractors, designers, and other project stakeholders. Support broader project controls activities, including progress measurement, reporting, cost and schedule integration, and project performance analysis. Maintain clear and organized documentation supporting schedule updates and analyses. Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Construction Engineering, Architecture, or a related field. Approximately 2 or more years of relevant construction industry experience, preferably working for a general contractor, construction manager, or specialty contractor. Practical experience developing or maintaining construction schedules. Understanding of construction sequencing, project milestones, and the relationship between design, procurement, and construction activities. Basic understanding of Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling principles. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to organize and analyze project information and communicate findings clearly. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Ability to work collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary project team. Preferred Experience using Oracle Primavera P6. Experience with Microsoft Project or other scheduling/project controls software. Experience working on commercial buildings, healthcare, higher education, transportation, infrastructure, or other complex construction projects. Exposure to schedule review, delay analysis, change-order evaluation, or construction claims. Familiarity with construction drawings, specifications, contracts, and project documentation. Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification or interest in pursuing professional certification is a plus. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate has started their career working directly within the construction industry and understands how projects are actually planned and built. They have had hands-on exposure to construction scheduling and are interested in developing deeper expertise in project controls, schedule analysis, and construction advisory . This position is particularly well suited to someone who has spent the first few years of their career with a contractor or construction manager and is interested in transitioning into a consulting environment where they can work across multiple projects, clients, and construction sectors. What You Will Develop In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop expertise in: Advanced CPM scheduling Primavera P6 Construction schedule review and analysis Project controls and performance reporting Schedule risk and critical path analysis Change and delay analysis Construction claims and dispute support Project advisory and owner representation You will work alongside experienced construction, engineering, scheduling, and project controls professionals and gain exposure to complex projects from both the contractor and owner perspectives. For more information, please visit www.socotec.us Job Type: Full Time (4 days a week in office with one hybrid/ remote day) The position may be based in our Atlanta, New York, or Boston office. Some travel to project sites and client offices may be required depending on project assignments. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. SOCOTEC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Omni Channel Distribution & 3PL Operations Coordinator
description:
About Formlabs:

Do you want to change how the world creates?

At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Your Impact: Joining Formlabs as a Omni Channel Distribution & 3PL Operations Coordinator is a high-impact opportunity to be the final link in our global chain. You are the person who ensures the promise we make to our customers is kept. From resolving order sync errors to coordinating with regional carriers like FedEx and UPS, you make sure our printers leave the dock and reach the customer without friction. If you’re a proactive "figure-it-out" person who loves working in a fast-paced environment and wants to make a tangible impact on customer satisfaction, we want you on our team.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead the daily monitoring of regional order flows, ensuring that all customer orders sync correctly between Shopify, NetSuite, and our 3PL warehouse management systems.
  • Oversee the resolution of order exceptions, such as address validation errors, inventory stockouts, or SKU mismatches, to prevent shipping delays and customer friction.
  • Direct the coordination of daily carrier pickups, working closely with warehouse staff and partners like FedEx, UPS, and DHL to ensure all "shippable" orders leave the dock on time.
  • Implement inventory reconciliation tasks by assisting in weekly cycle counts and investigating discrepancies between physical warehouse stock and digital records.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success teams to provide real-time updates on high-priority orders, transit delays, or regional delivery disruptions.
  • Drive shipping accuracy by auditing outbound packaging and documentation for regional compliance, ensuring all domestic and international labels meet carrier requirements.
  • Analyze daily fulfillment reports to identify "aging" orders that have exceeded our processing SLAs, escalating bottlenecks to the Senior Coordinator or Regional Head.
  • Support the execution of regional returns and "Reverse Logistics," ensuring that returned products are processed, inspected, and restocked or disposed of according to company policy.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for resolving sync errors, ensuring that 'stuck' orders are identified and cleared within 24 hours.

About You:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain or a related field; equivalent operational experience will also be considered.
  • Solid understanding of order-to-cash cycles and basic warehouse operations (receiving, put-away, picking, and shipping).
  • Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift hourly.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise updates to both internal teams and external 3PL partners.
  • A proactive, "figure-it-out" attitude with a commitment to high-quality execution and customer satisfaction.

Bonus Skills:

  • Basic proficiency in Excel for data entry and simple report generation.
  • Experience using Shopify, NetSuite, or common Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).
  • Familiarity with regional carrier networks and basic domestic shipping regulations.
  • Experience in a fulfillment, warehouse, or logistics coordination role, ideally within a high-growth e-commerce environment.

title: Project Manager, IPP
description:
New Leaf Energy is an experienced clean energy developer that partners with landowners, policymakers, and other stakeholders to accelerate the transition to a world powered by renewable energy. We identify high-value sites, work with landowners and local communities to develop them, and partner with long-term asset owners to bring the most impactful clean energy projects to life.

Position Summary 

The Project Manager, IPP (“PM”) is responsible for the day-to-day execution of projects during construction and commissioning. This role manages contractors, schedules, budgets, and site activities to ensure projects are executed safely, efficiently, and in alignment with approved plans. The PM operates within established cost, schedule, and technical frameworks and escalates risks, changes, and issues in accordance with the IPP’s organizational and governance structures.

Position responsibilities will include, but are not limited to: 

Project Execution

  • Lead day-to-day execution of assigned projects to commercial operation.
  • Serve as the IPP’s primary point of contact for EPC contractors, major suppliers, and third-party inspectors during construction, escalating commercial disputes or high-impact technical issues
  • Support commissioning, performance testing, and punch-list resolution.
  • Prepare and organize COD documentation and turnover materials.
  • Review EPC Contractor and vendor compliance with PWA, insurance, and other contract requirements
  • Identify and document contractor performance issues or contract deviations, escalating to senior leadership for formal notice preparation and resolution
  • Assist in organizing commissioning schedules, tracking punch-list items to completion, and compiling turnover documentation for the Asset Management team.

Schedule, Cost, and Reporting

  • Maintain and update detailed project schedules and construction plans.
  • Track weekly project expenditures against approved budget, update progress tracking models, and review contractor invoices against progress tracking models. 
  • Prepare accurate, timely project reports for senior leadership, lenders, and internal stakeholders.
  • Identify schedule and cost risks early and escalate with clear documentation and recommendations.

Change Management

  • Identify potential changes in scope, cost, or schedule and initiate change orders.
  • Coordinate technical evaluation with the Director of Engineering and commercial review with senior leadership.
  • Log potential change orders, collect backup documentation (cost estimates, schedule impacts) from contracts, and support senior management in reviewing change order packages. 
  • Implement approved changes and track execution impacts.

Quality, Safety and Compliance

  • Conduct routine site visits, safety observations, and progress verification.
  • Coordinate factory acceptance testing logistics, schedules, and documentation with vendors, EPCs, and Engineering.
  • Escalate safety incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
  • Support incident investigations and corrective action implementation in coordination with senior leadership and contractors.

Desired Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
  • At least three years of renewable energy construction or project management experience (IPP or EPC).
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, contractor management, and site safety.
  • Experience supporting change management and contract administration.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and escalation judgment.

 

Compensation

New Leaf Energy compensates all employees in three ways: market-competitive base salary, plus above-market variable compensation, plus an equity-like program such that all employees experience the benefits of ownership.  We use a data-driven and transparent methodology to calibrate compensation that is externally competitive and internally equitable, guided by the New Leaf Energy compensation manual, which is available to all employees.

Under our compensation framework, the likely base salary range for this position in the Boston location is $117,043 - 136,939. The on-target annual cash bonus associated with this position is an additional 10% percent of base salary. Your actual salary may be above, in, or below this range, depending on your location and experience.

We value transparency and can share more during the interview process.

 

Benefits and Culture

New Leaf Energy’s success is driven by our collaborative, long-term relationships based on trust and transparency. We offer a flexible work environment that places significant responsibility in independent teams and creates opportunities for innovation and personal growth. New Leaf Energy’s benefits are designed to appropriately recognize our employees’ contributions and enable a reasonable work/life balance. Our benefits include:

  • Competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental and vision;
  • A 401k plan with immediate vesting and a company match (100% of the first three percent of your pay; 50% for the next two percent you contribute);
  • An open and self-managed paid time-off policy;
  • A hybrid work location policy that supports working from home for part of the week;
  • A parental leave policy for both birthing and non-birthing parents, available immediately upon hire;
  • Professional development and education assistance.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

New Leaf Energy values the diverse perspectives, skills, experiences, and contributions of all employees. We want all our employees to feel like they belong and are empowered to be their most authentic selves at work. We’re actively committed to fostering diversity and creating an inclusive environment not only within our own organization but also within the clean energy industry.

We seek a diverse candidate pool in this–and every–search. New Leaf Energy provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, disability, genetics, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by state, federal and local laws. In addition to federal law requirements, New Leaf Energy complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. EEO M/F/D/V.

A Note to Third-Party Recruiters

New Leaf Energy’s People + Culture team coordinates all recruiting and hiring at our company. New Leaf Energy does not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies. Resumes are only accepted from third-party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies if a signed agreement is in place AND if external recruiting assistance is authorized by the People + Culture team for a specific position. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of New Leaf Energy. New Leaf Energy is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Mechanical Project Manager
description:
About Formlabs:

To reinvent an industry, you have to build the best team. Join Formlabs if you want to join us in our mission to build the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life. 

Formlabs is looking for highly motivated individuals to join us as we bring groundbreaking professional 3D printers to every designer, engineer, factory floor and medical institution throughout the world! Companies like Google, Tesla, Gillette, and New Balance rely on the products and services that Formlabs provides, and the list is always growing. Join the exciting 3D printing industry where the possibilities are endless, innovation is at the core of what we do, and we strive to solve unique customer challenges.

R&D: Join a dynamic R&D team, comprising top-tier mechatronics, software and systems engineers. We’re a collaborative group driven by innovation and great product development to develop the Formlabs printing process and bring transformative products to market. 

Your Impact: 

The mechanical project manager makes sure our prototyping and development process is efficient and executed firmly. At Formlabs we’re constantly iterating on our products and building new prototypes. As the engineering project manager you’ll work with the mechanical engineering team and the engineering team broadly to bring these prototypes to life and once they’re built to make sure they’re being maintained and used effectively. You’ll also work closely with the mechanical engineering team to support the complexities of developing hardware such as managing BOMs, inventory and product configurations. This is a role that benefits from energizing your peers and has high visibility as your results are our highly coveted prototype products.

What You’ll Do:

  • Be the glue to pull disparate teams together to hit key milestones and goals through the product development process
  • Manage (in conjunction with the G$ team) the Bill of Materials for our products making sure it is up to date and usable for ordering, cost analysis and useful for tracking development status.
  • Push ECOs through the release process and make sure they’re implemented in a controlled manner.
  • Develop spaces for builds including workspace, tools, shelving for inventory and finished goods
  • Manage inventory for prototype and integration builds including receiving parts, managing incoming quality control, stocking parts and prepping for builds.
  • Make sure that prototype builds happen smoothly and as quickly as possible. Run daily standups or other methods of work tracking and motivation to make sure builds remain unblocked. 
  • Organize and plan work. Motivate team members. Track progress and issues. Communicate with stakeholders and close out issues.
  • Manage the configuration of our fleet of prototype printers. Maintain an up to date inventory of prototype printers, their configuration, status and use. Ensure that reworks and retrofits happen quickly and successfully.
  • Improve processes across mechanical engineering to support the smooth development of products
  • Broadly support the mechanical engineering team and mechanical engineering manager as project manager embedded in that team

About You:

  • Demonstrates motivation to bring amazing products to life by pushing yourself, your peers and the development process forward
  • Consistent and organized to make sure we’re doing everything we can to succeed
  • Ready to get your hands dirty filling gaps and leading by example
  • Can jump between organizing data to organizing people and back during the course of a day
  • A working knowledge of technical documentation and the desire to keep learning in this area
  • Build bridges between team leads and key doers on teams to quickly solve problems and blockages

Bonus Skills: 

  • Depth in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or integration software
  • Data analysis and spreadsheet wizardry
  • Experience with PLM systems

Our Benefits & Perks:

  • Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • 401K matching and access to financial advisors
  • Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)
  • Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks)
  • Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it
  • Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits
  • Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats
  • Regular sponsored professional development opportunities
  • Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community
  • And of course… unlimited 3D prints

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.  

Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.

Our Candidate AI Guidelines are available here. Please give them a read.

Every Formlabs employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. You’ll have the opportunity to share financially in the value we create together, with a shared incentive to build a business that succeeds over the long term. Equity will be a significant portion of your total compensation, and will increase over time in proportion to your impact. The base pay will be determined by your skills, qualifications, experience, location, and expected impact on the organization.

$60,000—$95,000 USD
